ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Biomedical Ultrasound Imaging. Prerequisites: ECE 329. The overall objective of this course is to familiarize the students with most of the theoretical and engineering foundations of ultrasonic imaging. Conventional, Doppler and advanced ultrasonic imaging techniques will be described. Students will be introduced to important applications of the different ultrasonic imaging techniques. Engineering problems related to image production, quality and system design will be examined.
